text.en:
Today you learn to say what you have.
I have a ticket.
It means: the ticket is with me.
I have a sore throat.
It means: my throat hurts.

With I, you, we and they, say have.
They have a car.
With one other person or one thing, say has.
She has a ticket. The hotel has a luggage room.
To ask, use Do or Does, and have is short again.
Does she have her passport?

You will say what people have, and ask about it.
You will also say what you do not have.
I do not have a booking.
She does not have her glasses.
Do you have a charger?
